description: 24 вопроса из практики Норм-ассистента SINTARIS (учёт сертификатов медизделий, регламенты MDR/IVDR). Источники: каталог сценариев UC1–UC23, контрольный набор вопросов реального бота (qa_golden_cert), демонстрация задания 8.1. Только вопросы, без текстов стандартов ISO.

tiers.simple: definition, abbreviation, one field of a record (status, date), a single named authority, one fixed number — answerable in 1–3 sentences
tiers.medium: a specific requirement or procedure from one regulation/article — needs regulatory knowledge, one source, a structured answer
tiers.hard: reasoning across several provisions — device classification by Annex VIII rules, transition provisions with conditions and evidence, comparison of two regulations, gap analysis, audit preparation
